about: The epistola of the formulary “Transferred Fifth Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: As God’s elect, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with heartfelt mercy, kindness, humility, modesty, and patience, bearing with one another and forgiving one another, if anyone has a complaint against another; as the Lord has forgiven you, so must you also forgive. But above all these things have charity, which is the bond of perfection. And let the peace of Christ exult in your hearts; in it you were also called in one body. And be thankful. Let the word of Christ dwell in you abundantly in all wisdom, as you teach and admonish one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual canticles, singing to God with grace in your hearts. Whatever you do in word or in deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, giving thanks to God the Father through Jesus Christ our Lord.
